were
found
in
the
digestive

tract
of
Tegula
funebralis ,
which
had
pH
optima
of
5.0 ,

8.6 ,
and
10.5 .

enzyme
extract
was
a
saline
homo-

centri-

fuged ,

filtered
through
a
Sephadex
G - 50

column .
The
substrate
used

sodium
caseinate .
